layout.why: You're getting this email because you take part in a Secret Santa on Givto.

sign-in.subject: Sign in to Givto
sign-in.preheader: Your code: {otp}. It works once, for 10 minutes.
sign-in.title: Sign in to Givto
sign-in.link: Or sign in with one click:
sign-in.expiry: The code and the link work once and expire in 10 minutes.
sign-in.ignore: Didn't ask for this? Then you can ignore this email.

delete-account.subject: Confirm deleting your Givto account
delete-account.preheader: Your code to delete your account. It works once, for 10 minutes.
delete-account.title: Delete your account?
delete-account.intro: Here's your code to delete your Givto account:
delete-account.effect: This removes your wishlist, your memberships, tips and questions. It can't be undone.
delete-account.expiry: The code works once and expires in 10 minutes.
delete-account.ignore: Didn't ask for this? Then you can ignore this email; nothing changes.

invite.subject: {organizer} invited you to {group} on Givto
invite.preheader: Join the Secret Santa: add your wishlist and wait for the draw.
invite.title: You're invited!
invite.body: {organizer} invited you to the Secret Santa “{group}”.
invite.expiry: This link is just for you and works once, for 7 days.
invite.ignore: Not interested? You can decline from the same link, or ignore this email.

join-reminder.subject: Still joining {group}?
join-reminder.preheader: {organizer} is waiting for you in the Secret Santa.
join-reminder.title: Still joining?
join-reminder.body: {organizer} invited you to the Secret Santa “{group}”, and you haven't joined yet. Join before the draw to be in it.
join-reminder.expiry: This link is just for you and works once, until your invite expires.
join-reminder.ignore: Not interested? You can decline from the same link. We won't remind you again.

join-request.subject: {name} wants to join {group}
join-request.preheader: Let them in, or not: it's up to you.
join-request.title: Someone wants to join
join-request.body: {name} used the group link to join “{group}”. You asked to approve new people first, so they're waiting for you.

joined.subject: You're in: {group}
joined.preheader: The organizer let you in. Time for your wishlist.
joined.title: You're in!
joined.body: The organizer let you into “{group}”. Add a few wishes so your Santa knows what to get you.

join-digest.subject: {count, plural, one {{name} joined {group}} other {# people joined {group}}}
join-digest.preheader: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} in now.
join-digest.title: {count, plural, one {Someone joined} other {# people joined}}
join-digest.body: Joined “{group}” through the group link yesterday:
join-digest.total: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} in now.

names-drawn.subject: Names are drawn in {group}!
names-drawn.preheader: Find out who you're buying for. It's a secret!
names-drawn.title: Names are drawn!
names-drawn.body: The draw for “{group}” is done. Open Givto to find out who your giftee is. Don't tell anyone!
names-drawn.address: Gifts go by post: add your address in Givto, so your Santa knows where to send yours.

giftee-changed.subject: You have a new giftee in {group}
giftee-changed.preheader: Something changed in the draw, and it affects you.
giftee-changed.title: You have a new giftee
giftee-changed.body: Someone joined or left “{group}” after the draw, so you're now buying for someone else. Everybody else keeps their giftee.

organizer-handover.subject: You're now the organizer of {group}
organizer-handover.preheader: The previous organizer deleted their account.
organizer-handover.title: You're the organizer now
organizer-handover.body: The organizer of “{group}” deleted their Givto account, so the group passed to you: you've been in it the longest. You can now invite people, change the dates and run the draw.

psst.subject: Psst! Your Santa has a request
psst.preheader: Someone is buying you a present and would love some help.
psst.title: Psst!
psst.emptyWishlist: Your Santa in “{group}” would love some ideas. Add a few wishes to your wishlist: it makes their job much easier.
psst.moreDetails: Your Santa in “{group}” would love a few more details about your wishes: sizes, colours, links.
psst.secret: We won't tell you who your Santa is. That's the fun part.

question.subject: Psst! Your Santa asked you something
question.preheader: An anonymous question from your Santa.
question.title: Your Santa asked…
question.intro: Your Santa in “{group}” has a question for you:
question.secret: Your answer goes to your Santa only. You won't find out who asked.

answer.subject: Your giftee answered your question
answer.preheader: Their answer is in. Happy shopping!
answer.title: You've got an answer

wishlist-updated.subject: Your giftee's wishlist changed
wishlist-updated.preheader: {count, plural, one {# new or changed wish} other {# new or changed wishes}} in {group}.
wishlist-updated.title: New on the wishlist
wishlist-updated.intro: Your giftee in “{group}” updated their wishlist.
wishlist-updated.added: {count, plural, one {New wish:} other {# new wishes:}}

wishlist.subject: Add a few wishes
wishlist.title: Your wishlist is empty
wishlist.body: Your Santa in “{group}” doesn't know what to get you yet. Add a few wishes: big or small, a link or just an idea.

address.subject: Add your address
address.title: Where should your gift go?
address.body: Gifts in “{group}” go by post. Add your address so your Santa knows where to send yours. Only your Santa sees it.

gift.subject: Got your gift yet?
gift.title: Got your gift yet?
gift.body: Gift day for “{group}” is {date}. Still shopping? Your giftee's wishlist has ideas.
gift.body-post: Your gift for “{group}” should be in the post by {postBy}, so it arrives before gift day ({date}). Their address is in Givto.
gift.mark: Got it already? Tap “I've got my gift” in Givto and we'll stop reminding you.

ready.subject: Ready to draw names
ready.title: Ready to draw names
ready.body: Everyone you invited by email has joined “{group}”: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} in. Draw names whenever you're ready.
ready.body-soon: Gift day for “{group}” is {date} and names aren't drawn yet. Draw them now, so everyone has time to shop.
ready.late: Anyone who joins after the draw still gets someone to buy for.

bring.subject: Bring a gift
bring.title: Bring a gift
bring.body: Gift day for “{group}” is {date}. Bring one wrapped gift: on gift day everyone picks one, or steals one.

lock-in.subject: Ready to lock in
lock-in.title: Ready to lock in
lock-in.body: Everyone you invited by email has joined “{group}”: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} in. Lock it in whenever you're ready; anyone who joins later is still in.
lock-in.body-soon: Gift day for “{group}” is {date} and it isn't locked in yet. Lock it in now, so everyone knows to bring a gift.

reminder-gift-day.subject: It's gift day! {group}
reminder-gift-day.title: It's gift day!
reminder-gift-day.body: Today's the day for “{group}”. Have fun unwrapping!

group-deletion.subject: {group} will be deleted on {date}
group-deletion.preheader: Nothing happened in this group for a long time.
group-deletion.title: We'll delete this group soon
group-deletion.body: Nothing happened in “{group}” for {months, number} months. To keep as little data as we can, we'll delete the group and its Secret Santas on {date}.
group-deletion.keep: Want to keep it? Start a new Secret Santa in the group before then.
